verdict.rationale: Empresa Online is an online company-incorporation service, so a buyer could reasonably ask about programmatic, agent-scoped access, and the axis applies. The evidence documents only human authentication: Cartão de Cidadão, Chave Móvel Digital, professional certificates and eIDAS. Post-registration access codes for the company card and permanent certificate, and SCAP role-based signing, are adjacent features, not issuable scoped API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
